description: List what needs the reader's attention, ranked: every error in the folder, then problems in documents they have read, rows of the folder's declared attention queries, and documents they read that changed since; with path, only what lies in that document or under that folder. Use it to triage what to look at first; for every problem whoever reads it use folio_health, and for only the documents changed since read folio_changes. It reveals what the reader has read. While the reader pauses sharing in Folio, it answers only {paused: true, message}. Answers {ready, needs: [{source: error, problem, attention or changed, path, line, block, what, name: the attention query's, at}], version: the same while the list is}; ready false, with no needs, while Folio still reads the folder. A list cut to fit one answer adds omitted, the entries each list left out, and narrow, how to ask for less.

path.description: A document, relative to the served folder or absolute under it, such as notes/plan.md, or a folder, such as notes/; omit for the whole folder

name: folio_needs
title: List what needs the reader
